usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.beta.threads.create(messages: [{ "role" => "user", "content" => "string", "attachments" => [{ "file_id" => "string", "tools" => [{ "type" => nil }] }], "metadata" => { "key" => "string" } }], tool_resources: { "code_interpreter" => { "file_ids" => ["string"] }, "file_search" => nil }, metadata: { "key" => "string" })
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.beta.threads.create(messages: nil, tool_resources: nil, metadata: nil) -> Models::ThreadObject

fields.name: messages
fields.description: A list of [messages](/docs/api-reference/messages) to start the thread with.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the thread was created.
